concepts.gloss_en: the speech/utterance of Torah and prayer

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are in the same lesson (lm1:75) and use the identical construct 'the speech of Torah and prayer,' equated with tzedek/righteousness and the rectification of the legs. The only difference is singular דבור vs. plural דבורים — plain inflectional number variation of the same word, not a homograph. Clean single concept.
